evals.setup: Node repo with a 340-line CLAUDE.md that includes the file tree, a story about a past outage, and `npm run e2e`, which package.json doesn't define. README.md repeats the setup steps from docs/setup.md. A CONTEXT.md mixes domain terms with env var names. No AGENTS.md, no .env.example; env vars are listed in CLAUDE.md and README.md.
expected_behavior: Works on a new branch and stages the changes without committing
Moves CLAUDE.md to AGENTS.md with git mv and leaves no CLAUDE.md behind
Renames CONTEXT.md to GLOSSARY.md and moves the env var names out of it
Creates .env.example as the only annotated list of env vars, and README.md and docs/setup.md link to it
Writes an AGENTS.md under 200 lines with no file tree and no outage story
Reports `npm run e2e` as a claim the code contradicts, with the fix, and leaves it out of the Commands block
Lists everything dropped from the agent instructions under Not done in the drafted PR body

evals.setup: Python repo using uv with a README.md and docs/ but no GLOSSARY.md and no CONTEXT.md. The docs use 'workspace' and 'project' for the same concept. A CLAUDE.local.md is present and gitignored.
expected_behavior: Calls the domain-modeling skill to build GLOSSARY.md
Asks the user which of 'workspace' and 'project' is the canonical term instead of picking one silently
Warns in the report that CLAUDE.local.md stops Claude Code from reading AGENTS.md
Writes commands that use uv, not pip, including a single-test-file command

evals.setup: Repo whose AGENTS.md says 'Never edit files in src/generated/' and 'Always use 2-space indentation', with a .prettierrc enforcing 2 spaces. docs/reports/2025-q3-audit.md names files that have since moved.
expected_behavior: Drops the indentation rule because Prettier enforces it, and lists it under Not done
Keeps the generated-files rule under Hard constraints and suggests a hook or permission deny for it in the report
Runs a cold-read check with a fresh sub-agent that reads only AGENTS.md
